_meta.name: English
app.name: SNAPter
tray.title: prototype 0.4
balloon.title: SNAPter
balloon.text: Running. Press a hotkey to capture.
overlay.hint: Enter - copy, Ctrl+S - save, Esc - cancel
overlay.hint_select: Drag to select an area. Esc - cancel
settings.tools_new_hint: Fill: a click paints the area of similar color (the size slider is how different a color may be, %). Spotlight: pick a place with a frame, everything around it is darkened (opacity is the strength). Magnifier: pick a place with a frame, a ring shows it larger (size is how many times). Untick what you do not need: the tool disappears from the panel.
props.text_style: Text style: plain, outline, plate, auto
tip.drag_text: Drag the frame to move the text
settings.title: Settings
settings.text_all_caps: All text always in CAPITAL letters (however you type)
settings.text_all_caps.tip: You type in small letters, the screenshot gets CAPITALS. A neural network reads big letters more easily. Works on new text.
settings.arrow_panel: Show the panel of directions and rotation of the arrow next to the tool panel
settings.arrow_panel.tip: While an arrow is selected, a small panel appears to the right of the tool panel: eight directions (up, down, sideways, diagonals), a 'flip' button and turns clockwise and counter-clockwise.
settings.rotate_step: Turn of the arrow by one click, degrees (1-90)
settings.rotate_step.tip: How many degrees one click on the rotate buttons turns the arrow. 15 gives a smooth turn, 45 goes through the eight directions.
tip.flip: Flip the arrow around (start and end change places)
tip.align.left: Align to the left edge of the group
tip.align.right: Align to the right edge of the group
tip.align.top: Align to the top edge of the group
tip.align.vcenter: Align the vertical centers (into one row)
tip.align.bottom: Align to the bottom edge of the group
tip.align.disth: Equal gaps horizontally (three objects or more)
tip.align.distv: Equal gaps vertically (three objects or more)
tip.rotate_handle: Drag to rotate (Shift: in steps; double click: make straight)
settings.theme_name.tip: The name of your theme, anything: for example 'My orange'. It appears in the list of color themes.
settings.theme_color.tip: The accent color of the theme (buttons, frame, selection) as a HEX code: # and six characters 0-9 A-F, for example #FF7A00 (orange) or #22C55E (green). The square on the right shows the color at once; a question mark means the code is not understood.
settings.theme_create.tip: Makes a theme of this color, chooses it and shows it in this window. It is kept after Apply.
settings.theme_bad_color: The color is not understood. A code like #FF7A00 is needed.
settings.tray_color: Color of the tray icon (the arrow and the filling inside), one of ten
settings.tray_color.tip: The color of the shape inside the icon. It does not depend on the color theme when the switch 'the color of the icon comes from the theme' below is off.
settings.tray_ink: Color of the outline of the tray icon
settings.tray_ink.tip: The color of the outline. It works when the switch 'the outline follows the taskbar' below is off. A black outline and a blue arrow is the look of the first icon.
settings.tray_follow_theme: The color of the icon comes from the program's color theme (off: the one chosen of ten is used)
settings.tray_follow_theme.tip: On: the color inside the icon changes with the color theme. Off: always the color you chose above.
settings.tray_follow_taskbar.tip: On: the outline is light on a dark Windows taskbar and dark on a light one. Off: the outline always has the color you chose above.
settings.dim_color.tip: The color of the dimming outside the region as a HEX code, usually black #000000. The square on the right shows the color.
settings.frame_color.tip: The color of the region frame: the word accent (the color of the theme) or a HEX code, for example #FF3B30. The square on the right shows the color.
settings.fullscreen_scope.tip: Which screen 'whole screen' captures: the one with the mouse now; always monitor 1 or 2 (numbers as in the Windows display settings; if there is no such monitor the main one is used); or all monitors together.
settings.button_px: Exact size of the tool buttons in pixels (22-64, 0 - as chosen above)
settings.button_px.tip: A number above zero replaces the choice small / medium / large.
settings.tool_panel_title: Tool panel (the buttons next to the region)
settings.props_panel_title: Bottom panel (presets, colors, size, copy, save)
settings.panel_fill.tip: Switch it off and the panel has no background: only the buttons stay on the picture. Harder to read, but some people want it.
settings.panel_opacity.tip: 100 is a normal panel, less lets the picture show through it.
settings.panel_radius: Corner radius of the panel (-1: from the theme, 0-40 pixels)
settings.panel_radius.tip: -1 takes the roundness from the color theme, 0 gives sharp corners.
settings.mod_enabled: Shift, Ctrl and Alt work at all (the main switch)
settings.mod_enabled.tip: Switch it off and the keys Shift / Ctrl / Alt stop changing the drawing and the region. They break nothing else.
settings.mod_hold: While you draw (the mouse button is held) the held key changes the result at once
settings.mod_hold.tip: For example, drawing a region or a rectangle with Shift gives a square.
settings.mod_tap: A plain tap of the key changes what is already drawn
settings.mod_tap.tip: After drawing, press and release the key (nothing else pressed). The action is applied to the selected object, or to the region itself if nothing is selected.
settings.mod_region: Acts on the region itself (the selection frame): square, from the center, rounded corners
settings.mod_region.tip: A rounded region is saved with transparent corners in PNG and WebP (in JPG and BMP the corners are white).
settings.mod_shapes: Acts on shapes and arrows: square, circle, 45 degrees, head, fill
settings.mod_shown: Which choices the lists below show (hide the unused ones to keep the page clean):
settings.preset_color.tip: The color of the preset as a HEX code (for example #E5322D). The square on the right shows the color.
settings.preset_size.tip: Size: line thickness, text size, step circle or blur block.
settings.preset_font.tip: The font of the text of this preset. Empty: the common font from the page 'Text, steps, arrows'. The arrow button opens a list. Verdana reads well, also for a neural network; thin faces (Light) read badly.
settings.preset_bold.tip: Bold and italic for this preset: an empty square is off, a tick is on, a filled square means as in the common settings.
settings.preset_align.tip: Alignment of the text of this preset: left, center, right (or as in the common settings).
settings.preset_head.tip: The head of the arrows of this preset: triangle, open, dot (or as in the common settings).
settings.preset_head_scale.tip: Size of the head in times: 0.5 is half the usual, 2 is twice.
tip.font: Font of the text of this preset
settings.preview_note: Preview: not saved yet. Apply keeps it, closing the window brings back the old look and icon.
settings.tray_click: Left click on the tray icon
settings.version_tip: Program version: big.middle.build. After a restart the number must match the one the assistant named.
settings.about: SNAPter. Settings are saved to config\settings.json (defaults stay untouched). Project folder:
settings.dim: Dimming of the screen while selecting, %
settings.hotkey_hint: Click a field and press the keys. Backspace clears the field. Tick the box to turn the hotkey on.
settings.tools_hint: Tools that are switched off disappear from the panel and their keys stop working.
settings.name_unique_hint: A file is never overwritten: when the name is taken the program adds a space and a number - name 2, name 3, name 4... (a colon is not allowed in Windows file names, so the time is written with hyphens).
settings.file_name: File name template ({yyyy-MM-dd} and {HH-mm-ss} are replaced by the date and time)
settings.tool_labels: Text labels next to the tool icons (when the toolbar is on the left or right)
settings.panels_draggable: Panels can be dragged (a thin grip appears on each panel)
settings.tool_order_hint: Order of the tool buttons (the tools themselves are switched on and off on the 'Tools' page):
settings.theme_new: Your own color theme: name, accent color, then 'Create' (it appears in the list above after Apply)
settings.tray_icon: Icon in the tray (near the clock). The first pen icon is called 'quill'.
settings.tray_follow_taskbar: The icon follows the light or dark Windows taskbar (off: it takes the colors of the program theme)
settings.frame_color: Color of the frame ('accent' is the color of the theme, or #RRGGBB)
settings.crosshair: Crosshair lines across the screen while selecting
settings.magnifier: Loupe with pixels, coordinates and color near the cursor while selecting
settings.size_label: Show the size of the region
settings.include_cursor: Show the mouse pointer in the screenshot
settings.fixed_size: Fixed size of a region, for example 800x600 (empty: off). A plain click then makes a region of this size; you can also click the size label and type a size.
settings.subfolder: Sub-folder inside the screenshots folder, for example {yyyy-MM} or {process} (empty: none)
settings.tokens_hint: In names and sub-folders: {yyyy-MM-dd} {HH-mm-ss} date and time, {window} title of the active window, {process} its program.
settings.remember_folder: Remember the last folder of 'Save as'
settings.copy_and_save: Saving also copies the picture to the clipboard
settings.open_folder_after: After saving show the file in Explorer
settings.sound: Play a sound after copy and save
settings.sound_note: The sound plays only when the box above is on. The Windows message near the clock is now always silent: there is one sound, and it is yours.
settings.fit_hint: When the region is big and the panels have no room outside it, the program tries in this order: the bottom panel in fewer lines, then smaller panels (down to the minimum scale), then the groups listed below drop out one by one (only the ticked ones: the rarely used buttons first, the presets and colors last) and, only if nothing helps, the panels go inside the region, as low as possible. Inside the region the chosen key moves the panels around clockwise: bottom right, bottom left, top left, top right corner.
settings.fit_enabled: Fit the panels to the size of the region (off: the panels behave as before)
settings.fit_min_scale: Smallest size of the panels, % of normal
settings.fit_hide: If it is still too tight, hide the less important groups (tick which):
settings.fit_item.actions2: Buttons Save as, Pin, Upload, GIF, Video, Scroll
settings.fit_fallback: When there is no room outside at all
settings.fit_fallback.inside: Move the panels inside the region
settings.fit_fallback.clamp: Keep the old way (press to the screen edge)
settings.fit_corner: The corner of the region where the panels appear first
settings.fit_corner_key: The key that moves the panels inside the region to the next corner
settings.fit_props_mode_hint: One for all profiles: the layout below is the same on every profile. Own for each profile: the profile key switches the bottom panel too. Full keeps everything, Ascetic is one line without the extra buttons, Minimal is only Copy, Save and Close. You can change each of them here.
settings.fit_layout: Which items of the bottom panel go on which lines
settings.fit_layout_hint: Groups: presets, colors, recent (recent colors), shape (fill and rounded corners), sliders, extra (font and arrow head), copy, save, actions2 (the other buttons), close. Separate them with commas; a vertical bar | starts a new line. For example everything on one line: presets,colors,recent,shape,sliders,extra,actions,actions2,close. If a line is too long the program wraps the rest below or merges lines.
settings.beautify_hint: A finished screenshot can be dressed up: put on a background (gradient, one color or none) with space around it, rounded corners and a soft shadow, like the screenshots in blogs. It is done when you copy, save or upload. In the editor the ‘Beautiful’ button (or Ctrl+B) switches it for the current capture; the box below turns it on for all captures by default.
settings.beautify_enabled: Dress up all captures by default
settings.beautify_colors: Own colors (for the ‘Own colors’ choice): the first and the second, for example #667EEA and #764BA2
settings.beautify_radius: Rounded corners of the screenshot, pixels
tip.beautify: Choose the beautiful look for this screenshot: a list of looks, each shown on your screenshot. Ctrl+B switches the chosen look on or off. Settings - Beautiful screenshot
beautify.menu_title: Beautiful look of this screenshot (a choice switches it on at once; Esc closes)
beautify.live: Your screenshot in the chosen look
settings.random_title: What may fall out at random (the button Random look here and the item Random look in the list when you hold Beautiful in the editor)
settings.random_dark: Allow dark looks and backgrounds (Neon, Cinema, dark bars and frames). Untick for light ones only
settings.random_wild: How unexpected: 0 - calm, 100 - with rotation, own backgrounds and rounded corners
settings.look_new_tip: Adds a new look with random settings. Like it - keep it; not - generate again or delete. Any look, built-in ones too, can be edited with the pencil on its picture.
settings.look_radius: Corner radius, px (-1 - as in the settings below)
settings.look_bar_color: Color of the bar or the bands
settings.look_text_browser: Text in the address bar (any text)
settings.look_text_polaroid: Caption under the screenshot (empty - no caption)
settings.look_bg: Own background: two colors (empty - the palette of the page)
settings.beautify_style: The look (click a tile; the colors, space and shadow below work for all of them):
autobuild.text:
SNAPter: the sources changed, building the new version...
It starts by itself in a moment.
autobuild.failed: The build failed. The previous version starts.
settings.auto_rebuild: Rebuild the program at the start when the code files changed (when the sources are next to it)
settings.auto_rebuild.tip: It does not matter who edited the code. At the start the program compares the sources with what it was built from and, if they differ, builds the new version itself (10-60 seconds, in a small window) and starts it.
settings.ratio_hint: The Tab key, while you select a region (and before it), walks through the ratios of the list below: the frame is pulled strictly in them. The first one is where the program starts. Put free first if you do not want a lock by default. Shift+Tab does not go back: it moves the panels inside the region clockwise (the key can be changed on the page "Panels for a big region"). If a region is already drawn and has no marks, Tab reshapes it to the next ratio, and the handles stretch it without breaking the ratio.
settings.ratio_flip: Turn it over by itself: 16:9 into 9:16, 4:3 into 3:4 (by the way you move the mouse)
settings.ratio_flip.tip: You chose 16:9 and then pull the frame downwards - it becomes 9:16, pull it sideways again - 16:9. A square never turns.
settings.ratio_list: The order in which Tab walks through the ratios (the first is the start):
settings.ratio_own: Your own ratio (for example 2.39:1 or 5:7; A4, A5 - paper):
settings.ratio_own.tip: Width:height, decimals allowed: 2.39:1. Also A3, A4, A5 and the word free.
settings.ratio_bad: Could not read it. Write it like 16:9, 2.39:1, A4 or free.
settings.ratio_dup: This ratio is already in the list.
settings.ratio_pic: The ratios in the order of Tab (the first is outlined)
settings.looks_sample: A caption on a screenshot: the font, the alignment and the plate change at once as you edit the settings.
settings.looks_text: A caption on a plate (Justify shows on several lines)
settings.sizes_dots: Quick sizes: big, medium, small (from the brush values)
settings.sizes_snap: Snapping: the edge of a shape sticks to the line of its neighbour
settings.sizes_snap_note: The orange line is the edge the shape sticks to
settings.fit_pic_title: What happens when the region grows
settings.fit_stage2: Tight: fewer lines, the less important hidden, smaller panels
settings.fit_stage3: Very tight: panels inside the region
settings.fonts_mine: My fonts (only these are in the font menus; the cross removes):
settings.fonts_find: Find among all installed fonts (for example Segoe):
settings.profile_edit_hint: Your own Full: on the Tools page untick what you never use (for example the magnifier), come back here and press Save current here on the Full row. From now on Apply turns your set on, and Restore original undoes your edit.
settings.icon_fill: Icon size inside its button, % (0 - as is). Big icons and a thin panel: icon 85-100%, a smaller button
settings.icon_fill.tip: The icon is stretched inside the button. The higher the percent and the smaller the button and the gaps, the thinner the panel with big icons.
settings.button_gap: Gap between the buttons outside, px (0-8)
settings.panel_pad: Inner padding of the panel, px (0-12)
settings.thin_caption: This is the tool panel with these values
settings.unsaved_tip: There are unsaved changes - press Apply
settings.remember_tab: Open the settings on the page where they were closed
settings.neural_on: On: the plate is only an outline
settings.baseline_explain: Base settings are your return point. Set the program up the way you like (or keep it minimal), press Save as base - and at any moment Return to base brings exactly these settings back in a second if something goes wrong. It complements export and import: export is a file to carry or archive, the base is a quick rollback button inside the program.
settings.reset_confirm: Return the settings to your base settings? The current ones are kept in settings.backup.json.
settings.baseline_save_confirm: Replace the earlier base settings with the current ones? The earlier ones are kept in settings.baseline.backup.json.
settings.baseline_saved: The base settings are saved. The button Return to base now brings them back.
settings.baseline_nothing: Nothing to save yet: the settings were not changed.
settings.baseline_none: There are no base settings yet. Set the program up as you like and press Save as base. Return the factory settings now (everything from zero)?
settings.factory_confirm: Return the factory settings, as in a freshly installed program? Your base settings stay, the current ones are kept in settings.backup.json.
settings.fit_drag_hint: Drag the items with the mouse: between lines, inside a line, into the lower frame to remove, and into the upper empty frame to start a new line. If a line is too long the program wraps the rest or merges lines.
settings.fit_pool: Not shown (drop here; Ctrl+C, Ctrl+S and Esc still work):
settings.fit_text_label: The same as text (for experts; a vertical bar | starts a new line)
sound.sys.Question: Question
settings.notification_seconds: How long a message stays, seconds
settings.fullscreen_in_editor: 'Whole screen' opens the editor with the monitor selected instead of saving at once
settings.editor_keys_hint: Click a field and press a key (a letter, a digit or F1-F12). Backspace returns the standard key. Works in the editor after the region is chosen.
settings.action_keys_title: Shortcuts after a capture (save, undo and others)
settings.action_keys_hint: Click a field and press the combination. Letters and digits need Ctrl, Shift or Alt; Delete, F1-F12, [ and ] work alone. Backspace turns a shortcut off, the Default button returns the standard one. Red frame: the same shortcut is used twice. Enter and its variants are set on the Enter page.
settings.key_duplicate: This shortcut is already used by another action
settings.preset_count: Number of presets per tool (keys 1-9; a change works after Apply)
settings.shared_color: One color for all tools (a new color is used by every tool)
settings.presets_hint: For every preset: color, size (thickness / text size / step circle / blur block), opacity %, and for shapes fill 0-2, rounded corners, for text style 0-3 (plain, outline, plate, auto).
settings.text_font: Text font (the name of a font installed in Windows)
settings.plate_color: Color of the plate under text ('auto' or #RRGGBB)
settings.outline_width: Thickness of the text outline, % of the text size (5-50)
settings.profiles_hint: A profile is a set of tools and the look of the panels. 'Full' - everything, 'Ascetic' - arrow, rectangle, text, 'Minimal' - only copy, save, close. Your own profile keeps the present tools and panel look.
settings.profile_cycle_hint: In the editor (before, while and after the region is drawn) the key above switches the profiles one by one, for this capture only. While you have not changed the order a capture starts with your saved setup (marked with a dot) and the key goes on down the list. Once you change the order every capture starts with the first profile of the list. Change the order with the arrows or by dragging the name.
settings.ratio_key: Key that switches the aspect ratio (with Shift: back)
settings.key_box_tip: Click the field and press the key you want. Backspace or Delete turn the key off.
settings.undo_tip: Undo the last change (while it is not saved)
tip.type_size: Click to type an exact size, for example 800x600
settings.upload_target: Where the 'Upload' button sends the picture
settings.upload_copy_link: Put the link (or the file path) into the clipboard after upload
settings.upload_folder: Folder for the 'A folder' target (for example the one Google Drive for desktop synchronizes: the file goes to the cloud by itself)
settings.gdrive_hint: Google Drive without a folder: in Google Cloud Console create a project, enable 'Google Drive API', create an OAuth client ID of type 'Desktop app', then paste its Client ID and Client secret below and press 'Sign in'. The program sees only the folder and files it created itself. The secret is kept in your own config\settings.json: do not put that file into a public repository.
settings.gd_folder_id: Folder ID (optional, replaces the name; the folder must have been created by this program)
settings.gd_public: Make the link public (anyone with the link can view)
settings.upload_test_sent: The test picture is being sent; the result will appear as a message near the clock.
settings.gd_waiting: Waiting for the browser: sign in there and allow access...
settings.webp_lossless: WebP without loss (the quality number is ignored, files are larger)
settings.format_hint: PNG - exact pixels, best for screenshots with text. JPG - small files, quality is adjustable. WebP - smaller than JPG at the same look, supported by browsers and Telegram. BMP - huge files, for old programs. The clipboard always gets PNG and a normal picture.
settings.delay: Pause for 'region after a delay', seconds
settings.window_snap: A plain click on a window selects the whole window
settings.neural: Neural-network safe text: a plate under text is drawn as an outline
settings.neural_hint: A neural network that reads the screenshot can take a contrast plate for an element of the page. With this option a text style 'Plate' (and 'Auto') uses an outline instead, which does not look like an interface element.
settings.mods_hint: How it works. 1) While you draw (the mouse button is held), hold a key: the effect shows at once. 2) After drawing, just tap the key (press and release it, nothing else pressed): the action is applied to the selected object, for example a rectangle becomes square or rounded, an arrow gets a second head. Actions: square / circle / 45 degrees, from the center (only while drawing), rounded corners, only horizontal or vertical, arrow with two heads, toggle fill.
msg.delay_started: The screen will be captured in {0} s
msg.hotkey_busy: This hotkey is already used by another program
msg.restart_busy: A recording, the editor or the settings are open: restart cancelled. Close them and start again
tip.rec_gif: Record the selected area as a GIF animation
tip.rec_video: Record the selected area as an MP4 video (FFmpeg needed)
tip.rec_scroll: Scrolling screenshot: the program scrolls the area with the mouse wheel and joins the pieces
tip.size_slider: Thickness (size): drag the slider. Click the number to type your own value, even outside the slider range (only for the selected and new objects, until the region is closed).
tip.size_type: Type a size in pixels and press Enter
tip.pct_size: Size as a percent of the region height: {0}%
overlay.hint_pick_gif: Select the area to record as a GIF. Esc - cancel
overlay.hint_pick_video: Select the area to record as a video. Esc - cancel
overlay.hint_pick_scroll: Select the area to scroll. Esc - cancel
msg.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg was not found. Set the path in Settings (GIF and video) or put ffmpeg.exe in PATH
msg.scroll_started: Scrolling the area, do not touch the mouse. Esc - stop
settings.sizes_hint: Brush sizes, snapping of objects, the strength of Shift/Ctrl/Alt and what the Enter key does in the editor.
settings.size_min: Size: left end of the slider
settings.size_max: Size: right end of the slider
settings.size_min.tip: The ends of the size slider in the bottom panel. A typed size may go beyond them: it applies only to the selected and new objects until the region is closed.
settings.opacity_min: Opacity: left end of the slider, %
settings.opacity_min.tip: The lowest value of the opacity slider (the right end is always 100).
settings.pct_title: Quick sizes: big / medium / small button
settings.pct_hint: The size of the brush, marker, line and eraser as a percent of the region height. Three numbers separated by commas: big, medium, small.
settings.pct_tip: For example 100,50,30. 100 is the height of the whole region.
settings.snap_title: Snapping to the axes of other objects
settings.snap_hint: Hold the key while dragging an object (or placing a numbered step): it sticks to the vertical or horizontal axis of another object. Drag further than the threshold and it comes off.
settings.strength_hint: While you draw and hold the key, the mouse wheel changes the strength of the action from 0 to 100%. Here: default values and the wheel step.
settings.enter_title: The Enter key in the editor
settings.enter_hint: What Enter does, alone and with a held key. Ctrl+C always copies, Esc closes.
settings.tray_shift.tip: A plain click on the icon selects a region. What a click with Shift held does.
settings.record_hint: GIF is made by the built-in encoder. MP4 video goes through FFmpeg. While recording, a red frame with a timer and a Stop button is drawn round the area (it is not recorded). Pressing the hotkey again also stops the recording.
settings.record_frame: Show the frame, the timer and the Stop button
settings.record_editor_buttons: GIF / Video / Scroll buttons in the bottom panel of the editor
settings.gif_max.tip: The recording stops by itself. Long GIFs are very heavy.
settings.gif_scale.tip: Makes the picture smaller: 50 is half on each side. The file gets lighter.
settings.gif_colors.tip: Fewer colors - a smaller file but a rougher picture.
settings.rec_copy_file: After recording, put the file on the clipboard (can be pasted into Telegram)
settings.video_hint: The FFmpeg program is needed. If the path is empty, PATH and the usual folders are searched (for example C:\ffmpeg\bin).
settings.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg was not found - video recording is unavailable.
settings.video_codec.tip: H.264 plays everywhere. H.265 is smaller. NVIDIA - encoding by the video card (if it supports it).
settings.video_preset.tip: Faster - less load on the PC but a bigger file. veryfast suits screen recording.
settings.video_rate_mode.tip: CRF - constant quality (recommended). Bitrate - constant data rate.
settings.video_crf.tip: The smaller the number, the better the quality and the bigger the file.
settings.video_bitrate.tip: Used in the Bitrate mode. 6000 is good for a window, 15000 for the whole screen.
settings.video_maxrate.tip: Limits the peaks of the data rate in the CRF mode.
settings.video_pixfmt.tip: yuv420p suits all players. yuv444p is sharper for text but does not play everywhere.
settings.video_audio_device.tip: The list comes from ffmpeg (DirectShow). If the one you need is missing, enable Stereo Mix in Windows or install a virtual cable and press Refresh the list.
settings.open_in_viewer: After a shot, open the saved file in the standard Windows image viewer
tip.drag_row: Drag with the mouse up or down and drop where the row should stand
settings.pin_panels_tip: Pin the panels: while this is checked, the editor panels are always shown to the right and below the settings window, as if the window were the selected region. You see at once what changes. Uncheck it when all is set. Without it the panels still appear for 5 seconds after any change.
settings.mark_panels_tip: Outline: while this is checked, an orange frame marks the parts of the panels that the open settings page changes (the panels stay shown).
settings.video_extra.tip: Extra command line keys, for experts. Empty - not needed.
settings.scroll_hint: The program scrolls the selected area with the mouse wheel, takes the pieces and joins them into one long screenshot. Do not touch the mouse during the capture. Esc - stop.
settings.scroll_delay.tip: Time for the page to settle and load. Raise it for heavy pages.
settings.scroll_notches.tip: One scroll step. A smaller step joins more reliably.
settings.scroll_max_height.tip: The capture stops when the screenshot reaches this height.
settings.scroll_skip_top: Fixed header at the top, px
settings.scroll_skip_bottom: Fixed footer at the bottom, px
settings.scroll_skip.tip: A sticky header or bar that does not scroll: it is not joined again.
settings.scroll_tolerance.tip: How many rows of the overlap may differ (animations, cursor). A bigger value joins more forgivingly.
settings.scroll_start.tip: Time to release the keys after the area is chosen.
settings.scroll_copy: Copy the result to the clipboard
settings.scroll_show: Show the result in a pinned window
tip.head_fill: Arrow head: filled or an outline (a triangle or a dot drawn by a line only, as thick as the arrow itself, empty inside)
tip.opacity_slider: Opacity: left - more transparent, right - more solid
